g.text: What is actually extended below catalog ML 2?

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4c4c4c

g.text: Independent Wood–Anderson ML is the scaling variable; catalog ML defines the pilot draw
Original processing gives seven paired-A events, measured ML 1.78–2.23; the NW2 window candidate reaches ML 1.48. No revised primary relation is adopted.
The A/B sensitivity adds 20 events to the 357-event reference; bootstrap/CV resamples or withholds whole families. These controls do not remove SNR selection bias.
